title: vl03: Gram-Schmidt says terms with |Phi_k> = 0 are left out; it must be |Psi_k> = 0 (the script's own footnote)

legacy.old_text: where summands with $|\Phi_k\rangle= 0$ are left out.
legacy.new_text: where terms with $\ket{\Psi_k} = 0$ are left out (c03.prop.gram-schmidt)

reason: In the sum of the Gram-Schmidt formula the denominator is ||Psi_k||^2, so the terms to omit are those with |Psi_k> = 0 (division by zero), not |Phi_k> = 0. The v0.2 footnote at vl03.tex:216 says so ('Gemeint ist |Psi_k> = 0'); the text was left unchanged. TJO says it correctly in lecture v04 [33:36]-[34:16]. The new chapter writes |Psi_k> = 0 in the proposition and gives the reason in the text; there is no footnote.

evidence.independent_check: read in the script sources at the stated lines; property 1 of the procedure with zero vectors skipped is checked by evidence/derivations/c03/check_c03.py (c03.cl.gram-schmidt, c03.cl.gs-null)
